title: Chaotic Beast Banquet
description: A surreal scene of anthropomorphic animals in formal attire seated at a long, messy dining table covered in spilled wine, cans, bottles, and food remnants. A roaring lion in a tuxedo, a woman with elaborate hair and dramatic makeup, and a snarling hyena are the central figures, surrounded by a frenzied crowd of shadowy beast-like creatures under a dripping, glowing yellow neon light structure.
prompt: A dark surreal painting of a chaotic banquet with anthropomorphic animals. A roaring lion wearing a tuxedo sits at a long messy table covered in spilled wine, beer cans, and food waste. Beside him is an elegant woman with dramatic makeup and styled hair, and a snarling hyena. Shadowy beast creatures celebrate wildly in the background under a glowing dripping yellow neon light formation. Dramatic lighting, painterly brushwork, dark atmosphere.
